# Project Governance

## Purpose

Define the durable change-control purpose.

## Authority map

Register the authoritative owner for each concern, including documentation structure.

## Change control

Define branch/PR, scope, technology, and significant-decision controls without operational command sequences.

## Goal hierarchy

Define Product Goal, Use-case Goal, single-level non-product Goal, executable work, dependencies, priority, and proportional-delivery rules once.

## Architecture and module control

Define durable architecture/module change-control rules and reference their narrower authorities.

## Definition of done

Define project-level acceptance invariants; reference workflow for executable validation procedure.
